in_sanskrit.name: भक्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is devoted to a personal God or a deity; a devotee, a worshiper.

in_hindi.name: भक्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: bhajanīy, one who is worthy of being worshipped or adored

in_tamil.name: பக்தன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is devoted to a personal God or a deity; a devotee, a worshiper.

in_telugu.name: భక్త
in_telugu.long_meaning: dēśēy, pryajjēy, one who is worthy of being worshipped or adored

in_marathi.name: Bhakt
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhakt हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is devoted to a personal deity or path in life. Derived from the Sanskrit root bhaj, which means 'to serve' or 'to adore'. In Hinduism, a bhakt is a person who seeks to connect with the divine through devotion and service to others.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhakt একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is devoted to a personal deity or path in life. Derived from the Sanskrit root bhaj, which means 'to serve' or 'to adore'. In Hinduism, a bhakt is a person who seeks to connect with the divine through devotion and service to others.
